text:
Anna C.: Quick sync — we need to lock Q3 GTM scope for the PLG seller launch. Sales asked for +20% MRR target; we need clear launch criteria (SLOs, enablement, telemetry). Can we align on MVP vs full scope?
Raj P.: We're pushing for full onboarding flow in launch. Target = 120 new orgs by EOY. Need dedicated enablement playbook + 3 seller demos.
Emily S.: I agree on the target but we can't do the full playbook without a narrower product scope. Proposal: split into MVP + full. MVP = core API + 1 self-serve template + 2 demo videos.
Tom R.: MVP sounds reasonable. Eng estimates: 6w for API + infra work, +2w for docs. Can we use feature flags for the canary test so sales can demo while we iterate?
Raj P.: :thumbsup: Feature flags good if rollback is trivial. What's the SLA expectation for canary?
Martin S.: We can meet p50 ~150ms on hosted for typical MVP traffic. p95 will be ~600ms — need to set canary thresholds and throttling/backoff behaviour.
Jessica M.: Enablement deliverables I need to own: 1) seller playbook, 2) 3 demo scripts, 3) 60min webinar + 1-pager. I can do #1 and #2 in 3 weeks if product gives final feature list this week.
Anna C.: Draft launch criteria (proposal): 1) API routes stable + docs beta, 2) JS & Python SDKs in GA or beta-ready, 3) 2-week canary with <1% error rate and rollback plan, 4) enablement assets published. Acceptable?
Raj P.: JS/Python SDKs are must-haves. Error rate target ok assuming retries/backoff implemented client-side. Also want seller beta pool (~10 pilots).
Emily S.: Marketing requests: feature matrix for comms + two PLG experiments at launch (onboarding email loop, trial quota tweak). Need a telemetry hook for conversion metrics and activation events.
Martin S.: We'll emit events for onboarding steps and usage. Which exact conversion metrics do you want tracked?
Emily S.: Top metrics: 1) activation = first 3 successful calls, 2) session length / feature depth, 3) trial->paid conversion within 14 days. Also funnel drop-offs for onboarding.
Tom R.: Scope negotiation summary: must-haves = SDKs, API stability, telemetry for experiments. Nice-to-haves = advanced routing, Dedicated capacity docs. Plan: ship MVP with feature flags + canary + A/B experiments for onboarding email.
Anna C.: Action items: @Martin S. finalize canary thresholds by Fri (ts 1895012376), @Jessica M. confirm enablement timeline by Mon (ts 1895012440), @Raj P. confirm sales baseline today. I'll update the roadmap doc after that.
Raj P.: I'll confirm baseline today and recruit 10 pilot accounts for the beta.
Jessica M.: Confirmed — playbook draft by Mon, will sync with product for screenshots.
deploy-bot: roadmap doc updated -> /docs/q3-plg-seller-roadmap-v1 (versioned).
